greeting.text: ...Another one. I'm Nacht Faust. I don't waste time on people who lose, so don't lose.
You'll be asking about devils sooner or later. Everyone does. Nacht Faust. Ask quickly.
So you're the new one. Hm. You look tougher than you sound. Name's Nacht.
You put Vetto down. Good. I don't like noise from beasts. Nacht Faust. Sit, if you want. I won't.
Plenty of fights behind you, and you're still standing. Not an idiot, then. Nacht Faust.

hint.text: First rule: losing is your own fault. Second rule: so is dying. Third rule: don't make me repeat the first two.
Noise and light. Everything down there counts them. A torch draws attention, and noise draws more. If you can't fight it, don't let it see you.
The Eye of the Midnight Sun has a devil at its root. Zagred, its secret founder. You'll meet his people first. Don't underestimate them just because they're human.
Zagred is down the Chasm, somewhere below the fortieth floor. A devil of words: say it and it becomes true. You can't win by listening. Plug your ears, if you have to.
Three brothers, three devils: Lucifero, Megicula, Beelzebub. Gravity, curses, space. Devils lend power and take payment. The Zogratis paid with everything they had.
Astaroth, the devil of time, was bound to Lucius. A devil that can fold hours. Whatever you plan, he's already thought of it. So plan twice.
Seven people from another world, each carrying a sin. Nothing to do with devils. Nothing to do with me. That's what makes it interesting.
That other dungeon breeds monsters the way mine breeds regrets. Efficiently. Don't go in unprepared.
Twenty or more victories. Fine. I'll admit it: you're not an idiot.
Liebe is anti-magic. Zagred is words. Megicula curses. Lucifero crushes with gravity. Beelzebub tears space. Astaroth bends time. Know the name, know the trick.

Mine are different: Slotos the horse, Gimodelo the dog, Plumede the cat, Walgner the rooster. In Unite Mode each lends me its body for thirty seconds: a fortress, a pack, a stalker, a stunning call. Those pages open only in my own grimoire.
Shadow Travel works if you stand in shadow and there is a shadow to land in. The labyrinth is generous with both.
A five-leaf grimoire may carry a devil. Devil Union is what it grants. Don't envy anyone who has one. The devil always collects.
Zagred is down? Good. Devils lie. He lied loudest.
The whole Dark Triad is down. Three contracts broken at once. I almost feel sorry for their devils. Almost.
Lucius, finished. A man who chose a devil of time and still ran out of it. Poetic.
My brother Morgen died stopping a ritual that tried to bind a devil. I haven't forgotten the lesson. Devils are not tools.
Asta talks too much. Noelle sulks too much. Everyone eats too much. It's an exhausting squad. ...I'd die for them.
I wear four relics on a string around my neck. They're not jewelry. Don't touch them.
The captain doesn't care about rank. I do. Rank is how you tell who has to pay.
If you want to talk about feelings, find Vanessa. She's drunk. It will be a good conversation.
Shadow is my road, but darkness will weaken you if you stay in it. Carry a lantern anyway.

farewell.text: Go. Come back with something worth saying.
If you see a devil, don't trust its smile.
